title: Molecular dynamics reveal potential effects of novel VHL variants on VHL-Elongin C binding in ccRCC patients from Eastern India.
authors: Chatterjee, Srilagna; Paul, Nirvika; Das, Anwesha; Bank, Sarbashri; Bankura, Biswabandhu; Yadav, Ravi Prakash; Sarkar, Kunal; Saha, Soumen; Malakar, Subhajit; Choudhury, Sunirmal; Ghosh, Sudakshina; Das, Madhusudan
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子动力学模拟和蛋白-蛋白对接分析VHL突变对VHL-Elongin C结合的影响，属于蛋白质-蛋白质互作而非TF-DNA体系，但MD方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作研究。
abstract: Renal cell carcinoma (RCC) is the one of the most fatal and frequent form of urological malignancy worldwide. The von Hippel-Lindau (VHL) tumour suppressor gene is a critical component of the VHL-Cullin2-ElonginB/C (VCB) complex that regulates the ubiquitin-mediated proteasomal degradation of proteins with mutations consistently associated with the development of clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC). Despite extensive investigations conducted worldwide, there is a notable lack of data concerning VHL mutations in sporadic ccRCC patients from India. Our study aimed to investigate the sporadic VHL mutations within the tumours of 210 ccRCC patients without a familial history of VHL disease. We extracted genomic DNA from tumour and adjacent normal tissues, PCR amplified and sequenced the VHL gene. In silico tools were used assess the damaging potential of missense variants on pVHL structure and stability. Protein-protein docking and protein flexibility molecular docking simulation study were employed to study the interaction between wild-type and mutated VHL models with Elongin C. Sequence analysis revealed seven novel missense mutations in patient tumour tissues p.(Val170Phe), p.(Arg69Cys), p.(Phe76Leu), p.(Glu173Asp), p.(Leu201Val), p.(His208Leu), p.(Arg205Pro). I-Mutant 2.0 indicated these mutations reduced pVHL stability (DeltaDeltaG < -0.5 kcal/mol). Protein Flexibility-Molecular Dynamic (MD) Simulation study indicated that mutations weaken the interaction of VHL with Elongin C, with V170F showing the most significant reduction in binding quality and stability. In conclusion, this study introduces novel genetic data from an understudied population and highlights the impact of VHL mutations on its interaction with Elongin C. These findings contribute to our understanding of the molecular basis of VHL-related pathologies and may guide future therapeutic strategies targeting these interactions.
abstract_zh: 肾细胞癌（RCC）是全球最常见且最致命的泌尿系统恶性肿瘤之一。von Hippel-Lindau（VHL）肿瘤抑制基因是VHL-Cullin2-ElonginB/C（VCB）复合体的关键组成部分，该复合体调控泛素介导的蛋白质蛋白酶体降解，其突变与透明细胞肾细胞癌（ccRCC）的发生密切相关。尽管全球范围内已进行了广泛研究，但关于印度散发性ccRCC患者中VHL突变的数据仍显著缺乏。本研究旨在调查210例无VHL病家族史的ccRCC患者肿瘤组织中的散发性VHL突变。我们从肿瘤及相邻正常组织中提取基因组DNA，通过PCR扩增并测序VHL基因。利用计算机模拟工具评估错义突变对pVHL结构和稳定性的潜在损害。采用蛋白质-蛋白质对接和蛋白质柔性分子对接模拟研究，探讨野生型与突变型VHL模型与Elongin C之间的相互作用。序列分析在患者肿瘤组织中发现了七种新的错义突变：p.(Val170Phe)、p.(Arg69Cys)、p.(Phe76Leu)、p.(Glu173Asp)、p.(Leu201Val)、p.(His208Leu)、p.(Arg205Pro)。I-Mutant 2.0表明这些突变降低了pVHL稳定性（DeltaDeltaG < -0.5 kcal/mol）。蛋白质柔性-分子动力学（MD）模拟研究表明，突变削弱了VHL与Elongin C的相互作用，其中V170F在结合质量和稳定性方面表现出最显著的降低。总之，本研究引入了来自研究不足人群的新遗传数据，并强调了VHL突变对其与Elongin C相互作用的影响。这些发现有助于我们理解VHL相关病理的分子基础，并可能为针对这些相互作用的未来治疗策略提供指导。
